data.name: Mohnish
data.gender_notes: Mohnish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to charm or attract'. The name Mohnish signifies the grace and blessings of the Moon god. It is believed that this name brings prosperity and happiness to the bearer. The name Mohnish carries the meaning “Moon god's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohnish usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and guidance
data.etymology: Mohnish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon god's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohnish total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the Moon god is considered a symbol of various virtues, including purity, peace, and fertility. The name Mohnish, hence, carries the blessings and powers of the Moon god. It is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to the bearer.

vedic_reference.note: Mohanish is a variation of the name Mohan, which is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to delight' or 'to attract'. It is also the name of the Hindu god Mohan, who is a form of Lord Krishna, known for his enchanting and captivating nature.
